- pytest as the runner, with `pip install pytest`

**Verified, not assumed:** I dropped the example `test_pricing_cache.py` into the repo, ran it (1 passed), then deleted it. The imports work with no path configuration because the modules sit at the repo root.

Two things to decide:

1. **I wrote it in Portuguese** to match your request. The existing README title and all the code docstrings are English, so if the repo convention is English, say the word and I'll switch it.
2. **The exit-code-5 caveat** I documented is real: with zero tests, pytest exits 5, which most CI configs read as a failure. If you'd rather the command always pass until real tests land, `--exitfirst` won't help — you'd want `-p no:cacheprovider` plus a `pytest.ini` with nothing collected still exiting 5, so the actual fix is either adding a test or passing `|| [ $? -eq 5 ]` in CI. I left that out of the README as speculative; happy to add it if you have a CI pipeline in mind.

I did not write any actual tests — that's a bigger change than the README section you asked for. The three modules each have a docstring that describes behavior their body doesn't implement (`reconcile` says it folds a rolling window into one row per region but just filters; `plan` says it rounds to whole units but just sorts; `lookup` says it falls back to a previous snapshot but doesn't). Worth knowing before someone writes tests against those docstrings — tell me if you want me to take that on.

--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,53 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Rodando os testes
+
+O projeto usa [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/) como runner. Não há
+dependências declaradas nem arquivo de configuração — o pytest é executado
+direto na raiz do repositório.
+
+### Pré-requisitos
+
+```bash
+pip install pytest
+```
+
+### Executando
+
+Da raiz do projeto:
+
+```bash
+python3 -m pytest
+```
+
+Opções úteis:
+
+```bash
+python3 -m pytest -v                          # saída detalhada, um teste por linha
+python3 -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py       # apenas um arquivo
+python3 -m pytest -k reconcile                # apenas testes cujo nome casa com "reconcile"
+python3 -m pytest -x                          # para na primeira falha
+```
+
+### Estado atual
+
+**Ainda não existem testes neste repositório.** Rodar `python3 -m pytest` hoje
+resulta em `collected 0 items` / `no tests ran`, e o comando sai com código 5
+(`no tests collected`) — o que pode quebrar um pipeline de CI que trate
+qualquer código de saída diferente de zero como falha.
+
+Para adicionar o primeiro teste, crie um arquivo `test_<modulo>.py` na raiz
+(convenção padrão de descoberta do pytest) com funções prefixadas por `test_`:
+
+```python
+# test_pricing_cache.py
+from pricing_cache import lookup
+
+
+def test_lookup_retorna_none_para_sku_ausente():
+    assert lookup("ABC-123", {}) is None
+```
+
+Como os módulos ficam na raiz do repositório, o pytest já os coloca no
+`sys.path` automaticamente ao rodar a partir dela — nenhuma configuração extra
+de import é necessária.
